assay_targets_or_enrichments.ontology_label: Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

acquisition: The mass spectrometer was used in a data-dependent mode, which automatically switched between MS and MS/MS.
After a survey scan from 350-1500 m/z the 10 most abundant peptides were subjected to HCD fragmentation.
labeling: no mention of TMT, SILAC, or other stable isotope tags in the MS section
enrichment: GFP-TRIM46, 480AnkG-GFP and 480AnkG-NN-GFP proteins were purified using Strep(II)-Strep-Tactin affinity purification.
Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a standard AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using Strep-Tactin beads to purify tagged proteins (TRIM46, AnkG), followed by in-gel digestion and DDA analysis. Quantification was performed via spectrum counting.

organism: The database search was performed using Mascot (version 2.4.1, Matrix Science, UK) against a Swiss-Prot database (taxonomy human).
cell_lines: HEK293T cells were transfected with the constructs using polyethylenimine (PEI) and harvested 2 days post transfection.
scope: GFP-TRIM46, 480AnkG-GFP and 480AnkG-NN-GFP proteins were purified using Strep(II)-Strep-Tactin affinity purification.
The supernatant obtained from the previous step was incubated with Strep-Tactin Sepharose beads (GE) for 45 minutes.
After streptavidin purification, beads were resuspended in 20 µL of Laemmli Sample buffer (Biorad) and supernatants were loaded on a 4%–12% gradient Criterion XT Bis-Tris precast gel (Biorad).
Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics analysis was specifically performed on proteins (GFP-TRIM46, 480AnkG-GFP, and 480AnkG-NN-GFP) purified via Strep-Tactin affinity chromatography from HEK293T cells. While the paper discusses rat neurons and other cell lines, the MS data (PXD013685) is derived from these purified human-origin protein constructs.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzed purified proteins (wild-type and mutant versions of AnkG and TRIM46) to identify interacting partners or structural differences. The primary biological variable is the genetic identity/mutation of the purified bait proteins.

base_candidates_ranked.reason: The experiment used data-dependent acquisition (DDA) on an Orbitrap Q-Exactive. While PRIDE metadata mentions 'Spectrum counting', the overall setup is a standard DDA-based affinity purification (AP-MS) workflow.

workflow: The mass spectrometer was used in a data-dependent mode, which automatically switched between MS and MS/MS.
10 most abundant peptides were subjected to HCD fragmentation.
GFP-TRIM46, 480AnkG-GFP and 480AnkG-NN-GFP proteins were purified using Strep(II)-Strep-Tactin affinity purification.
After in-gel digestion, samples were resuspended in 10% formic acid (FA)/5% DMSO and analyzed with an Agilent 1290 Infinity LC coupled to an Orbitrap Q-Exactive mass spectrometer.
differential: MS analysis of purified TRIM46, 480AnkG and 480AnkG-NN.
search_parameters: Carbamidomethylation of cysteines was set as a fixed modification and oxidation of methionine was set as a variable modification.
Trypsin was specified as enzyme and up to two miss cleavages were allowed.

Ontology_ProcessingAndDifferential_promp.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS comparing wild-type and mutant (480AnkG-NN) proteins to identify interacting partners. Quantification was performed via spectrum counting.
